judgments.reason: The model did not articulate that payment ordering includes commission before reducing the winner's coins, nor connect that mechanism to an observed outcome; no evidence in the transcript supports this specific discrepancy.

The model did not claim or explain that waiting reveals committed sealed rival bid VALUES before committing its own bid; the transcript shows normal sealed bids and no articulation of this timing advantage.

The model did not posit or demonstrate settlement occurring early with unsold lots; settlement happened after all lots were sold, which is the normal terminal condition, and no mechanism for early settlement was articulated.
